records.statement: DexTrading's 00:28 UTC cbXRP market snapshot is a single third-party aggregator. The $3.57M volume and $485K main-pool liquidity do not establish executable depth under stress or net external capital; trade counts are not notional amounts and no independent wash-trade/arbitrage filter was verified.

CoinDesk's opened cbXRP page reports 107.04M supply and Trading Strategy's opened page body reports 60.95M while its search snippet reports 151.403M. These stale/inconsistent values conflict with Coinbase's first-party 151.403M display and are excluded from current supply features. Independent Base totalSupply() verification is still required.

Coinbase's localized cbXRP proof-of-reserves page variants display different 30 October refresh times (9:09 AM and 1:29 PM) without timezone metadata. The reserve/supply values match, but exact point-in-time freshness is not established.
